title: KioskPanel — No One's Counting
objective: KioskPanel's admin PIN is short, and nothing stops you from trying every possibility. Find it.

verifier.condition: The correct admin PIN is submitted after more failed attempts than any reasonable lockout policy would have allowed.

weakness: The login endpoint places no limit at all on failed attempts — no lockout, no backoff, no CAPTCHA — so a short credential can simply be tried exhaustively.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /unlock (no attempt limiting of any kind)
seededData: A 3-digit admin PIN (000-999), different each instance. No lockout state exists anywhere in the application.
hints: Try a few wrong PINs in a row. Does anything change — a delay, an error, a lockout message?
A 3-digit PIN has exactly 1000 possibilities. That's a small enough number to simply try all of them.
Script the attempts rather than typing them by hand.
burpNotes: Use Intruder with a numeric payload from 000 to 999 (zero-padded) against the pin parameter, or script it with curl/Python. A real client is expected here — no shortcuts.
